bounded_time.mechanism: BASH_MONOSECONDS else /proc/uptime fixed window + fresh remaining per op + timeout -k kill-after
bounded_time.bound_note: responsive <= budget+2, TERM-ignore <= budget+kill+1, missing-timeout skips (never unbounded); stubs <=5s; parent killpg backstop
bounded_time.honesty_note: best-effort, NOT hard realtime: 1s resolution + ~2s KILL grace + ~1s scheduler; D-state/sync may exceed
